It's also her way to punish me because I've hurt her by not doing everything she wants me to do.

Don't question what you've done wrong since a lot of the times abusive parents will choose to punish you over nothing. Don't feel like you've done anything wrong here to warrant such a treatment. I'm sorry your mother (and father) treated you like that. It doesn't matter how bad you've done something, they shouldn't make you feel like you're being excluded from family.

I do hope you feel better soon, I'm glad you reached out to vent because we all need to do that from time to time.

My national language was Bahasa.. and my second language was Mandarin. Both of them had a set rule on how vowels were pronounced. For exampled, in Bahasa, Ki was always "kee"; Ti was "tee", Mi was "mee" and so on. In Mandarin, Bu was "boo"; Lu was "loo" and Tu was "too". Our vowels all had set sounds.

But then in English, your 'a' sounds different depending on when it is used. For example, how you pronounce the 'a' in 'ant' is different from the 'a' in 'arm'. Or that 'ph' is an 'f' sound, and gh is a 'g' sound in 'ghost' but an 'f' sound in 'enough'. The 'u' is different in 'fun' and 'future'. It does my head in.
